name: xomtra
description: History, catalog and findings of your Home Assistant, from your Xomtra server in the LAN.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a Xomtra server on your local network. Issue a personal token in the Xomtra admin GUI (Tokens) and enter it here. Read-only: Xomtra never changes anything in Home Assistant.

url.title: Xomtra address
url.description: MCP endpoint of your Xomtra server, e.g. https://xomtra.lan/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Token from the Xomtra admin GUI (Tokens), starts with xmt_

ca_file.title: Certificate of the server (optional)
ca_file.description: xomtra-ca.crt from https://<server>/xomtra-ca.crt when the server uses its own local certificate

allow_http.title: Allow unencrypted http://
allow_http.description: Only for a server on a trusted network without HTTPS
